headline: TIDAL RUSH goes aerial: five verbs in the air
lede: Slot b's never-dry pick landed the oldest open gap on the weakest title: the bay now has five airborne verbs. Brake alone off a crest winds a BACK FLIP worth +300; gas-and-brake holds a HANDSTAND that pays every half-second you hang inverted — and whichever trick finishes first owns the air. All of it rides the six bits the online wire already hashed, so three-player rooms referee flips for free.

notes.text: Five airborne verbs (+300 flip, +150/half-second handstand, one-trick-per-air law kept whole), with rivals now throwing seeded back-flips of their own.
tidalcheck 149 → 155 gates (determinism-with-tricks included) and all three new mutants caught — the one-trick lockout is load-bearing, not decoration.

Rule-8 catch: idle-kick aimed at a gap that had shipped hours earlier — the README entry was never struck. Struck both stale lines; lanes must strike gaps in the PR that ships them or the next slot gets phantom-kicked.
QA tail #3281 filed: grab poses, inverted splash, phone coaching for the two new verbs, attract-mode flip show-off.
